title: Cops Uncover Disturbing Child Abuse Involving Chicken Coop
description:
Bodycam footage shows a New Mexico home being searched after police were informed a dad was locking up his daughter in a chicken coop on the property. Jammy Jackson and Patricia Madris were arrested and denied the allegations, claiming the 15-year-old was able to come and go as she pleased. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
